verdict.rationale: Rainforest is an embedded payments platform that pays out to merchants, so international seller payouts are a fair question for it. The evidence covers deposit frequency, ACH validation via Plaid, and US-centric payment methods. Nothing documents local-currency payouts, FX handling, or settlement to non-US local bank rails.

support.subject: As a finance lead, international sellers get paid properly — local-currency payouts, documented FX handling, and settlement to local bank rails rather than expensive wires
